scientific_integrity: Exact universal proof and reproducible finite checks; no claim of independent validation or exhaustive historical coverage.
scientific_limitations: Only odd prime-power fields, monic quadratics, and the first three iterates; fourth and later iterates, characteristic two, and nonmonic cases are unproved here. A possible equivalent earlier count in inaccessible historical literature remains a research risk.
title: Exact three-iterate irreducibility profile of monic quadratics over odd finite fields
